name: Her Gilded Stage
source:
This is a micro visual novel is loosely based on and inspired by Trilby, a 1894 novel written by George du Maurier. 

[from [url=https://waffrus.itch.io/her-guilded-stage]itch.io[/url]]

这是一部微视觉小说，大致以乔治·杜毛里埃 (George du Maurier) 于1894年创作的小说《特里尔比》(Trilby) 为基础并受其启发。

[来自[url=https://waffrus.itch.io/her-guilded-stage]itch.io[/url]]
